thread.title: PDP, MEXX: Big ETF Outflows

author: BNK Invest
title: PDP, MEXX: Big ETF Outflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Looking at units outstanding versus one week prior within the universe of ETFs covered at ETF Channel, the biggest outflow was seen in the PowerShares DWA Momentum Portfolio ( PDP ), where 3,750,000 units were destroyed, or a 11.0% decrease week over week. Among the largest underlying components of PDP, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is down about 0.4%, and Mastercard ( MA ) is lower by about 0.6%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest outflow was the Daily MSCI Mexico Bull 3X Shares ( MEXX ), which lost 50,000 of its units, representing a 33.3% decline in outstanding units compared to the week prior.
